overview: The app covers a job search from end to end: finding roles, applying, following each application, interviews and offers. Your résumé is the one on your ICR profile.
before: A résumé on your profile. The app builds one from your profile's experience and skills.
A mobile number. The app asks for it the first time you apply if your profile has none.

rules: The free plan includes a set number of applications a month; the form shows how many are left, and **See plans** shows the plans with more.
You cannot apply to a job your own company posted.

after: When a recruiter books an interview, it appears under **Up next** and in your notifications.
An offer appears on the application's page, where you accept or decline it.

website: Building several résumés and the résumé coach.
Writing a review, a salary or an interview experience for a company. You can read them in the app.
